aboutCompanyText:
Shreeji Shipping Global Ltd is a leading provider of integrated shipping and logistics solutions for dry bulk cargo across various ports and jetties in India and Sri Lanka. As of March 31, 2025, our operational fleet includes over 80 vessels—comprising barges, mini bulk carriers (MBCs), tug boats, and floating cranes—and more than 370 earthmoving equipment, such as material handling machines, excavators, pay loaders, tippers, trailers, tankers, and other vehicles.

Our services span over 20 key ports and jetties, including major Indian ports like Kandla, non-major ports such as Navlakhi, Magdalla, Bhavnagar, Bedi, and Dharmatar, and the international port of Puttalam in Sri Lanka.

The company offers end-to-end logistics and shipping solutions for dry bulk cargo, covering both cargo handling and transportation services. Our cargo handling operations include STS (Ship-to-Ship) lighterage, stevedoring, and port-based cargo management services. As part of our logistics chain, we also offer transportation services from port to customer premises and vice versa.

Service Offerings:

We cater to clients across diverse industries, including Oil & Gas, Power & Energy, FMCG, Coal, and Metals.
